external_sources.implication: The remaining route should model day-state and sleep-transition context jointly.
external_sources.takeaway: ETRI 2024 is explicitly built around passive 24-hour sensing from smartphones, smartwatches, sleep sensors, and self-reports for sleep quality and stress prediction.
external_sources.title: Understanding Human Daily Experience Through Continuous Sensing: ETRI Lifelog Dataset 2024

external_sources.implication: A future runner should preserve all 12 modalities and their missingness patterns.
external_sources.takeaway: The official data page lists 12 public lifelog streams and frames the task as sleep health, fatigue, and stress prediction from daily-life records.
external_sources.title: The 4th ETRI Human Understanding AI Paper Challenge data page

external_sources.implication: Image layout is useful as a representation prior, but local ID342 smokes say it is not enough alone.
external_sources.takeaway: PixleepFlow treats synchronized lifelog streams as composite images and targets sleep/stress jointly, reinforcing the need for cross-channel state representations.
external_sources.title: PixleepFlow: A Pixel-Based Lifelog Framework for Predicting Sleep Quality and Stress Level

external_sources.implication: The next design should use cross-modal alignment/fusion with explicit robustness checks.
external_sources.takeaway: The survey emphasizes modality heterogeneity, alignment, noise, and missing modalities as central multi-modal time-series challenges.
external_sources.title: Multi-modal Time Series Analysis: A Tutorial and Survey

external_sources.implication: This is a strong template for phone/watch/sleep-context modality dropout and fusion.
external_sources.takeaway: CroSSL masks modality-specific latent embeddings and aggregates them into a global representation, while handling missing modalities without negative-pair sampling.
external_sources.title: CroSSL: Cross-modal Self-Supervised Learning for Time-series through Latent Masking

external_sources.implication: Missingness should be a first-class token, not a preprocessing nuisance to fill away.
external_sources.takeaway: LSM-2/AIM learns directly from inherited real-world missingness plus artificial masks instead of requiring explicit imputation.
external_sources.title: LSM-2: Learning from Incomplete Wearable Sensor Data

external_sources.implication: Use 30-minute to multi-hour windows as semantic units instead of minute-level reconstruction only.
external_sources.takeaway: TimeMAE raises masked modeling from individual points to sub-series semantic units, reducing cost and improving label-scarce transfer.
external_sources.title: TimeMAE: Self-Supervised Representations of Time Series with Decoupled Masked Autoencoders

external_sources.implication: Subject-day neighborhoods are plausible, but validation must prevent date/subject leakage.
external_sources.takeaway: TNC learns representations for non-stationary time series by contrasting local temporal neighborhoods against non-neighboring windows.
external_sources.title: Unsupervised Representation Learning for Time Series with Temporal Neighborhood Coding

external_sources.implication: Use as a secondary objective only after missingness-aware cross-modal masking is fixed.
external_sources.takeaway: TS2Vec learns hierarchical timestamp and subsequence representations through contrastive learning.
external_sources.title: TS2Vec: Towards Universal Representation of Time Series

method_candidates.execution_shape: Tokenize each modality into aligned day/evening/sleep-transition units, keep inherited missingness masks, apply artificial modality/window masking, and learn cross-modal reconstruction plus latent aggregation.
method_candidates.risk: Needs heavy no-submit Kaggle execution and strict fold-internal downstream review.
method_candidates.why: Matches the 12-stream incomplete lifelog setting and directly targets latent subject state for Q3/S3.

method_candidates.execution_shape: Build 30-minute, 2-hour, evening, and sleep-transition tokens; reconstruct masked semantic units with visible/masked decoupling.
method_candidates.risk: Can collapse into another generic sequence summary unless cross-modal missingness is retained.
method_candidates.why: The dataset is label-scarce and long-horizon; semantic sub-series windows are more relevant than point loss.

method_candidates.execution_shape: Use small modality-specific encoders, latent masks, and a global aggregator; downstream uses frozen embeddings plus low-capacity fold-internal heads.
method_candidates.risk: May be too small to close a 0.046 public gap unless paired with AIM-style inherited masking.
method_candidates.why: The raw streams have natural missing modalities and different sampling frequencies.

method_candidates.execution_shape: Contrast same-subject nearby windows against distant windows without labels or public-score donors.
method_candidates.risk: High leakage risk if neighborhoods are not fold- and date-safe; not a standalone first route.
method_candidates.why: Q3/S3 are state-transition targets, so local temporal smoothness is plausible.

method_candidates.execution_shape: Train contextual encoders on synchronized sequences and aggregate target-specific windows.
method_candidates.risk: Less directly matched to missing modality and cross-device behavior than AIM/CroSSL.
method_candidates.why: Hierarchical timestamp/subsequence embeddings are broadly useful for irregular lifelog windows.

method_candidates.execution_shape: Use only as a visualization/channel-layout prior inside a stronger masked model.
method_candidates.risk: Do not launch another image-only or random-conv route from current evidence.
method_candidates.why: Image conversion is domain-relevant, but local sequence-image and tiny CNN gates did not open Q3/S3.

research_implications.action: Do not spend DACON on alpha, temperature, target-swap, or image-only variants.
research_implications.evidence: ID342 is still +0.0460832519 from Public 0.55 after 11/12 local routes closed.
research_implications.finding: The large public gap is representation-sized, not calibration-sized.

research_implications.action: Use inherited missingness tokens plus artificial masks as a core SSL objective.
research_implications.evidence: ETRI/DACON expose multi-device lifelog streams with varied sampling and natural gaps.
research_implications.finding: Missingness must be modeled, not erased.

research_implications.action: Pretrain a shared day/evening/sleep-transition encoder and test Q3/S3 with frozen embeddings.
research_implications.evidence: Prior Q3/S3-only handcrafted, sequence-summary, SOL, prior, and PCA gates failed.
research_implications.finding: Q3 and S3 need joint subject-state context.

research_implications.action: Use channel layout for masking and explanation only inside stronger cross-modal SSL.
research_implications.evidence: PixleepFlow supports synchronized sensor images, but local ID342 image/CNN smokes did not pass.
research_implications.finding: Image-style layouts are useful as priors but not sufficient.
